Yes, this is just how I'd want to bring in my current pile. It pulled in the whole lot in one go, turned my browser folders into labels so my rough organizing carried over, and — the part I really care about — it skipped the handful I'd already saved here without trampling the notes and edits I'd made on them. And I like that nothing happened until I saw the summary and said go.

One thing I'd want to be sure of, since these are links I've had for a while: that each one keeps its original name and the date I first bookmarked it, so when I later sort by "newest" or go looking, the history isn't all flattened to today. As long as the titles and original dates come across with them, this is exactly right. What's next?
